content.heading: Common Questions
content.description: Find out everything you need to know about our platform, billing, and support options.

faqs.question: How do I invite team members?
faqs.answer: You can invite team members from the Workspace Settings page. Click on 'Members' and enter their email addresses. They will receive an invitation link.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We also support PayPal and wire transfers for enterprise annual plans.

faqs.question: Can I export my data?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can export all your data at any time in CSV or JSON format from the Data Management section in your account settings.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom integrations?
faqs.answer: Custom integrations are available on our Enterprise plan. Our engineering team will work with you to connect our platform with your internal tools.

faqs.question: How long are backups kept?
faqs.answer: We keep daily backups for 30 days on all paid plans. Enterprise customers can request custom retention periods.

faqs.question: What happens if I exceed my usage limit?
faqs.answer: We'll never cut off your service immediately. You'll receive a warning email when you reach 80% and 100% of your limit, giving you time to upgrade your plan.
